svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.26.4.8 Chimney Saddles
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.26 ROOFING
Chimney Saddles

g.text: Saddle on the upper side of a chimney more
No saddle: sheet metal flashing up the chimney
and up the roof slope, (5) and (6)
Where the upper side of a chimney on a sloping roof is more than 750 mm (29½″) wide, except as permitted in Sentence (5).
Sheet metal or roofing material of weight and quality equivalent to the roofing.
Flashed where the saddle meets the roof. The saddle to chimney intersection is flashed and counterflashed as described in
Sheet metal flashing up the chimney at least one sixth of the chimney width, not less than 150 mm (5⅞″), and up the roof
slope to equal height, not less than 1.5 times the shingle exposure, counterflashed as in Article 9.26.4.4.

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Except as otherwise permitted in Sentence (5),
chimney saddles are installed where the upper side
of a chimney on a sloping roof is more than 750 mm
(29½″) wide.
Chimney saddles are covered with sheet metal or
roofing material of weight and quality equivalent to
the roofing.
Saddles are flashed where they intersect the roof.
The intersection of the saddle and the chimney is
flashed and counterflashed as described in Article
A chimney saddle need not be installed if the
intersection between the chimney and roof is
protected by sheet metal flashing that extends up
the chimney to a height equal to at least one sixth
the width of the chimney, but not less than 150 mm
(5⅞″), and up the roof slope to a point equal in
height to the flashing on the chimney, but not less
than 1.5 times the shingle exposure.
Flashing described in Sentence (5) at the chimney is
counterflashed as required by Article 9.26.4.4.
Drawn: A with the roof rising toward the front so the upper side of the chimney faces you, red lines mark the saddle flashing. B is cut through the upper side. Sizes are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.26.4.8. (page 9-244)
